job.title: Staff Digital Twin Engineer
job.description: We are looking for a Staff Digital Twin Engineer to help design, build and evolve digital twin capabilities that support the development, validation and operation of advanced AI compute systems.
responsibilities: Apply MBSE methodologies to drive the development of systems
Develop and deploy simulation logic and behavioral models
Develop robust scene composition and data modeling approaches
Collaborate across engineering to ensure interoperability
Establish engineering best practices for OpenUSD schemas
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers
